## 🤖 Merge briefing · {PARENT7}

- **Wrong:** the list view checked org-admin twice, and the two checks could drift; nobody has felt it yet.
- **Change:** one `_is_org_admin` helper behind the queryset narrowing, the balance column and the export.
- **Warranted: yes** — one view, the refactor the ticket asks for.
- **Judgement calls:** no shared mixin; the name kept as `_is_org_admin`.
- **Merge risk: high** — a permissions path over balances: what a sub-group admin saw, a revert does not take back.
- **Lane: human** — `payments/web/views/organization_bank_account_list_view.py` is a guarded path.
- **Read first:** `_is_org_admin` and its root-group lookup.
- **Also:** nothing.

**Recommendation: merge** — green, nothing owed.
<!-- agent-merge-briefing:end -->

## Summary

`OrganizationBankAccountListView` decided whether the requester is an org (root) admin in two places: inline in `get_queryset`, and in `_can_view_balance` for the balance column and the export. Both now call one `_is_org_admin` helper, so the two can't drift. No behaviour change.

Jira: [BAC-4412](https://hoopit.atlassian.net/browse/BAC-4412)

## Test plan

- `payments/tests/web/test_organization_bank_account_list_view.py` passes unchanged.

## Run before merge

- [x] `manage.py backfill_bank_account_balances --dry-run=false` against production — log in `docs/runs/BAC-4412-backfill.md`

<!-- agent-ledger:start -->
## 🤖 Agent ledger

| Round | Item | Call | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Extract a mixin shared with the detail view | declined | only this view asks the question today |
| 2 | CodeRabbit: rename `_is_org_admin` to `_is_root_admin` | declined | "org admin" is the domain term used across payments |
<!-- agent-ledger:end -->
